name: Funkwhale
description: Federated self-hosted music and audio streaming platform for building or joining a shared library.

envVars.description: Public hostname the instance is served from

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://funkwhale:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres/funkwhale"
      CACHE_URL: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379/0"
      FUNKWHALE_HOSTNAME: {{env.FUNKWHALE_HOSTNAME}}
      DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: {{env.DJANGO_SECRET_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
      - {{appDataPath}}/music:/music
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: funkwhale
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: funkwhale
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-front:
    image: funkwhale/front:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-front
    restart: unless-stopped
